openClinicalQuestions: Should WHD name a preferred first-line medical category for nulliparous patients seeking future fertility in India-facing copy?
What local haemoglobin threshold triggers same-week vs routine review in WHD clinics?

claimLedger.claim: Heavy periods may include changing pad/tampon every 1–2 hours, dual products, >7-day bleeds, clots >~2.5 cm, soaking clothes, activity limits, tiredness/breathlessness; lists fibroids, endometriosis, adenomyosis, PMOS/PCOS, bleeding disorders and rare womb cancer among causes.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Heavy periods · Page last reviewed: 19 September 2024
claimLedger.limitations: UK public advice; Indian product brands and referral routes differ.

claimLedger.claim: Prioritise quality-of-life impact; full blood count for all with HMB; LNG-IUS and other pharmacological categories; investigate based on history/examination.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NICE · Heavy menstrual bleeding: assessment and management (NG88) · Recommendations include 2007/2018 updates (page fetched 2026)
claimLedger.limitations: UK pathway; LNG-IUS off-label notes apply to some devices; prescribing remains clinician-led in India.
